keyVerseDR: "This is my commandment, that you love one another, as I have loved you." (Jn 15:12)

level1.title: Love One Another
level1.story: Jesus said, "Love one another as I have loved you." He calls us His friends. There is no greater love than to give your life for your friends.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you love like Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for being my friend. Amen.

activity.title: Love one another
activity.intro: Fill the Sacred Heart with love.

level2.title: You Are My Friends
level2.story: Jesus said, "As the Father hath loved Me, I also have loved you. Abide in My love." If they kept His commandments, they would abide in His love, and their joy would be full. "This is My commandment, that you love one another, as I have loved you." Jesus said, "Greater love than this no man hath, that a man lay down his life for his friends." He said, "You have not chosen Me: but I have chosen you."
level2.keyLine: Love one another, as I have loved you.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How does keeping commandments bring joy?
actions: Make a sacrifice for a friend
level2.prayer: Jesus, teach me to love as You love. Amen.

activity.title: Love in action
activity.intro: Match each situation to a loving choice.
pairs: A friend is left out at recess
Give her a hug and listen
A new kid comes to class
